The sheet is an operations agent test report, an evaluation dashboard of test cases, built in AI & Agents Advanced. It shows only the artifact's own content, never a caption or description of what it is, printed in clean modern sans-serif typography, near-black ink, generous margins and a clear hierarchy. Visible text, spelled exactly: "Golden set · 40 cases"; "Passed 37"; "Needs review 3". One small solid black printed block behind the "Needs review 3" figure, its text knocked out in white.
Nothing else in the frame: no hands, no people, no desk, no pens, no plants, no devices, no props, no logos. Monochrome only, gallery-quality print photography.
